data.name: Fleeman
data.gender_notes: Fleeman is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Fleeman is derived from the Old English words 'flea' meaning 'little' and 'man' meaning 'warrior'. This name was given to a small, brave warrior. In the Christian context, Fleeman can represent a faithful servant of God, always ready to fight for the right cause. The name Fleeman carries the meaning “Little warrior” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Fleeman usually hope their child will grow to embody little warrior and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of courage and faith in the face of adversity.
data.etymology: Fleeman belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Little warrior.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fleeman total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_hebrew.name: פילימן
in_hebrew.meaning: מקור השם פילימן לא נמצא במקורות עבריים מסורתיים
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם פילימן אינו מופיע במקורות עבריים מסורתיים. עם זאת, ניתן לראות כי השם קשור לשם היווני Φλημων (Phlēmōn), שפירושו 'אח', 'מקור של נחמה'. השם משויך לקונספט של נחמה ואחווה.

in_greek.name: Φλημων
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Φλημων (Phlēmōn) προέρχεται από την ελληνική γλώσσα και σημαίνει 'αδελφός', 'παρηγορητής'. Στο πλαίσιο της χριστιανικής παράδοσης, το όνομα συνδέεται με την έννοια της αδελφοσύνης και της παρηγορητικής αγάπης. Ο Απόστολος Παύλος αναφέρει ένα άτομο με το όνομα Φλημων στον Επιστολή προς Φλημωνα (Προς Φλημωνα 1:1).

in_latin.name: Fleeman
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Fleeman derivatum est ex vocibus hellenis et latinizatione nominis Phlēmōn. Significat 'fratrem', 'fontem consolationis'. In traditione christiana, nomen Fleeman refertur ad conceptum fraternitatis et consolationis. Nomen Fleeman est forma anglicana nominis greci Φλημων (Phlēmōn).

in_english.name: Fleeman
in_english.meaning: Fleeman means brother, source of comfort
in_english.long_meaning: The name Fleeman originates from the Greek name Φλημων (Phlēmōn), meaning 'brother' or 'source of comfort'. In Christian tradition, Fleeman symbolizes fraternity and solace. The name is associated with St. Philemon, a Christian saint and a companion of St. Paul. Fleeman represents a person who brings comfort and brotherly love.

It is a reminder that true strength comes not from physical stature or worldly possessions, but from the inner conviction and faith in God.
